items.title: 2026: The Year Agentic AI Becomes the Attack-Surface Poster Child
items.description: Dark Reading asked readers whether agentic AI attacks, advanced deepfake threats, board recognition of cyber as a top priority, or password-less technology adoption would be most likely to become a trending reality for 2026.

items.title: Out-of-the-Box Expectations for 2026 Reveal a Grab-Bag of Risk
items.description: Security teams need to be thinking about this list of emerging cybersecurity realities, to avoid rolling the dice on enterprise security risks (and opportunities).

items.title: Tenable Tackles AI Governance, Shadow AI Risks, Data Exposure
items.description: The Tenable One AI Exposure add-on discovers unsanctioned AI use in the organization and enforces policy compliance with approved tools.
